backfill_news.headline: EU Sustainable Aviation Fuel Supply Exceeds 2025 ReFuelEU Aviation Target
backfill_news.summary: The European Union reported that SAF supply exceeded the mandatory 2% target in 2025, reaching 2.8% (1.1 million tonnes). Used cooking oil remained the predominant feedstock at 80% of total SAF volume.
